        ],

    },
});

## Import



mongodb auditLogFile can be imported using the composite instance_id#file_name, e.g.

```sh
$ pulumi import tencentcloud:Mongodb/auditLogFile:AuditLogFile example cmgo-5aqo4yf7#1309118522_cmgo-5aqo4yf7_1780474413_109642711.csv
```



To learn more about importing existing cloud resources, see [Importing resources](/docs/using-pulumi/adopting-pulumi/import/).
